# Sell NFT

> Sell NFT by listing at a fixed price or accepting an offer. Compare marketplace fees, subtract creator royalties and seller-paid gas, and choose the sale with the strongest net proceeds.

## Pages
- [Sell NFT](https://insert_url/): Ethereum marketplace comparison, fee calculator, selling methods, transaction safety and FAQ.
- [NFT sale dashboard](https://insert_url/dashboard/): Compare individual offers, royalties and gas costs. Calculate an asking price from a target payout and save the comparison in the browser.

## Selling fees on Ethereum
- Blur: 0% marketplace fee.
- OpenSea: standard secondary-sale fee of 1%; private listings typically carry a 0% platform fee.
- Rarible: 2% seller fee on direct Ethereum listings.
- Creator royalties and network gas are separate costs.
- Fee review date: October 9, 2026.
- Sources: Blur marketplace homepage; OpenSea Help Center, "What fees do I pay on OpenSea?"; Rarible FAQ updated September 1, 2026.

## Calculations
Net proceeds = sale price * (1 - platform fee / 100 - royalty / 100) - seller-paid gas.
Required asking price = (target proceeds + seller-paid gas) / (1 - platform fee / 100 - royalty / 100).
The landing page compares the same price and costs across platforms. The dashboard accepts individual offers and selling costs for each platform.

## Selling methods
A fixed-price listing waits for a buyer. Accepting a funded offer moves directly to settlement. A timed auction adds a bidding period before settlement. The listing or offer specifies the payment token.

## Security
Match the contract address, token ID, price, payment currency and approval permissions before signing. Keep recovery phrases private and confirm payments on-chain.
